diagnosed_cause: The consent change handler could re-enable Start with an existing socket, while the Start handler did not guard an active connection. Withdrawing consent did not close the active session.
repair: Require no current socket before Start can become enabled or dispatch a connection
Withdrawing external reasoning consent calls existing session teardown, closing the socket, microphone tracks and AudioContext
Keep stale microphone permission callbacks and old socket events isolated from a new connection

verification.fixture_correction: AudioWorkletNode.connect fixture returns its destination, matching real Web Audio chaining so the installed-microphone path executes.

browser_ui_fixture.scope: UI fixture only; no model, ASR, microphone-ready message or provider

deployment: Separate experimental UI source only. Do not change the running recovery or prepared0619 fullnative20 collector. Git-deploy app separately after strict recovery/behavior gates; live GPU/ASR/provider/browser/audio qualification remains.
